dialog.en: Where's the remote?
Beats me. Check the couch.

dialog_zh: 遥控器在哪？——我也不知道，看看沙发。
tip: 口语随意，正式场合用 I'm not sure。

dialog.en: Want to grab a drink tonight?
I'll take a rain check — I'm swamped.

dialog_zh: 今晚喝一杯？——改天吧，我忙疯了。
tip: 礼貌拒绝且暗示以后愿意；也说 Can I take a rain check?

dialog.en: My audition is in ten minutes.
Break a leg!

dialog_zh: 我十分钟后试镜。——祝你好运！
tip: 不是诅咒！多用于表演、上台前。

dialog.en: Sorry I'm late.
Don't sweat it, we just started.

dialog_zh: 抱歉迟到了。——没事，我们刚开始。
tip: 回应道歉或安慰；比 No problem 更随意。

dialog.en: This traffic is killing me.
Tell me about it. I've been stuck for an hour.

dialog_zh: 堵车要命了。——可不是嘛，我堵了一小时。
tip: 语调下降表示同感，并不是真让对方讲。

dialog.en: I have an idea for the trip.
I'm all ears.

dialog_zh: 我对旅行有个主意。——洗耳恭听。
tip: 表示很想听；语气可真诚也可略带调侃。

meaning: 不会吧！别逗了！（表示惊讶）

dialog.en: I won the lottery!
Get out of here! Seriously?

dialog_zh: 我中彩票了！——不会吧！真的？
tip: 语气惊喜时是“不敢相信”，严肃说才是“滚出去”。

dialog.en: Finals week is brutal.
Hang in there, it's almost over.

dialog_zh: 期末周太惨了。——坚持住，快结束了。
tip: 用来鼓励处境艰难的人。

dialog.en: *keeps poking*
Cut it out! I'm trying to work.

dialog_zh: （一直戳）——别闹了！我在工作。
tip: 语气较冲，对熟人用；正式说 Please stop。

dialog.en: Anyone up for hiking Saturday?
I'm game!

dialog_zh: 周六有人去徒步吗？——算我一个！
tip: game 这里是形容词“乐意的”；也说 I'm game for it。

dialog.en: So, will you take the offer?
Let me sleep on it.

dialog_zh: 你接受这个offer吗？——让我考虑一晚。
tip: 委婉争取时间，商务中也常用。

dialog.en: Who told her about the party?
Tom spilled the beans.

dialog_zh: 谁告诉她派对的事？——Tom 说漏嘴了。
tip: 也可催人坦白：Come on, spill the beans!

dialog.en: Let's sign it now!
Hold your horses, read it first.

dialog_zh: 现在就签吧！——别急，先读一遍。
tip: 劝人冷静、别冲动；语气略带调侃。

dialog.en: It's 7pm already.
Yeah, let's call it a day.

dialog_zh: 都七点了。——是啊，今天就到这吧。
tip: 晚上也可说 call it a night。

meaning: 别对我那么苛刻；体谅一下

dialog.en: You forgot again?
Cut me some slack, I've been sick.

dialog_zh: 你又忘了？——体谅一下嘛，我病了。
tip: slack 是“松弛”，请求宽容。

dialog.en: Let's split the bill.
No, it's on me tonight.

dialog_zh: 我们AA吧。——不，今晚我请。
tip: 也说 It's my treat；on the house 是店家请。

dialog.en: Can you help me move?
You bet!

dialog_zh: 能帮我搬家吗？——当然！
tip: 热情肯定；美式口语。

dialog.en: Want to go out?
Nah, I'm beat.

dialog_zh: 出去玩吗？——不了，累死了。
tip: 不是被打；= exhausted。

dialog.en: It's late.
Yeah, I'm gonna hit the sack.

dialog_zh: 很晚了。——嗯，我去睡了。
tip: 同义 hit the hay；很口语。

phrase: It's not my cup of tea.

dialog.en: Do you like jazz?
Honestly, it's not my cup of tea.

dialog_zh: 你喜欢爵士吗？——说实话不太是我的菜。
tip: 委婉表达不喜欢；通常用否定。

dialog.en: How was the test?
Piece of cake!

dialog_zh: 考试怎么样？——小菜一碟！
tip: 形容事情简单。

dialog.en: You look pale.
Yeah, I'm a bit under the weather.

dialog_zh: 你脸色好差。——嗯，有点不舒服。
tip: 指小病不适，不用于重病。

dialog.en: You took my seat.
Oh, my bad!

dialog_zh: 你坐了我的位置。——哦，我的错！
tip: 很随意的道歉，正式场合用 I apologize。

dialog.en: Only $20 for these shoes?
It's a steal!

dialog_zh: 这鞋才20刀？——太值了！
tip: 形容价格极便宜，不是真偷。

dialog.en: Do you know Mark Lee?
Hmm, that name rings a bell.

dialog_zh: 你认识 Mark Lee 吗？——嗯，名字有点耳熟。
tip: 表示模糊记得；否定 doesn't ring a bell。

dialog.en: Where's Amy?
Speak of the devil, here she comes!

dialog_zh: Amy 呢？——说曹操曹操到，她来了！
tip: 完整版 ...and he shall appear；语气轻松。

dialog.en: I'll hear back next week.
Great, keep me posted.

dialog_zh: 下周有回音。——好，有消息告诉我。
tip: 职场常用；= keep me updated。

dialog.en: Can I leave early again?
Don't push your luck.

dialog_zh: 我能再早走吗？——别得寸进尺。
tip: 警告对方别太过分。

dialog.en: Thanks for fixing my bike!
No sweat.

dialog_zh: 谢谢帮我修车！——小事一桩。
tip: 回应感谢或请求；口语随意。

dialog.en: And it comes with free delivery.
Okay, I'm sold!

dialog_zh: 而且还免费送货。——好吧，我被说服了！
tip: 不是被卖掉；表示接受提议。

phrase: Off the top of my head.
meaning: 凭印象随口一说（未经查证）

dialog.en: How many people came?
Off the top of my head, about fifty.

dialog_zh: 来了多少人？——凭印象大概五十个。
tip: 表示答案可能不精确。

dialog.en: I can't come, I have work.
Fair enough.

dialog_zh: 我来不了，要上班。——行吧，理解。
tip: 接受对方理由，有时略带勉强。

dialog.en: What happened with the car?
Long story short, I need a new one.

dialog_zh: 车怎么了？——长话短说，得换辆新的。
tip: 放在句首，引出结论。

dialog.en: How's the new job?
So far so good.

dialog_zh: 新工作怎么样？——目前还不错。
tip: 暗含“后面还不确定”。

dialog.en: They announced it before approval.
They jumped the gun.

dialog_zh: 还没批就宣布了。——他们太心急了。
tip: 源自赛跑发令枪前抢跑。

dialog.en: What's the plan for tomorrow?
Let's play it by ear.

dialog_zh: 明天什么安排？——到时看情况吧。
tip: 表示不做固定计划。

meaning: 硬着头皮做（不愿做但必须做）

dialog.en: I hate the dentist.
Just bite the bullet and go.

dialog_zh: 我讨厌看牙。——硬着头皮去吧。
tip: 用于面对不愉快但必要的事。

dialog.en: She called me out of the blue.
After ten years?

dialog_zh: 她突然给我打电话。——十年后？
tip: 强调意外，常放句末。

phrase: Hit the nail on the head.

dialog.en: The problem is communication.
You hit the nail on the head.

dialog_zh: 问题在沟通。——你说到点子上了。
tip: 称赞对方说得准确。

dialog.en: Want some durian?
Thanks, but I'll pass.

dialog_zh: 要来点榴莲吗？——谢谢，我就不了。
tip: 简洁礼貌的拒绝。

dialog.en: I've never surfed.
Give it a shot!

dialog_zh: 我从没冲过浪。——试试看！
tip: = give it a try / have a go。

dialog.en: I'm moving to Mars.
You're pulling my leg.

dialog_zh: 我要搬去火星。——你逗我呢。
tip: 指善意开玩笑，不是恶意骗人。

dialog.en: Let's review the plan.
Good, so we're on the same page.

dialog_zh: 我们过一下计划。——好，确保大家想法一致。
tip: 职场高频；常说 get on the same page。

dialog.en: Do you still see your college roommate?
Once in a blue moon — maybe once every couple of years.

dialog_zh: 你还见大学室友吗？——难得一次，大概隔好几年才见。
tip: 强调频率极低；语气轻松日常。

dialog.en: I thought you were going to ask for the raise today.
I was, but I got cold feet in the hallway.

dialog_zh: 我以为你今天去谈加薪。——本来要去，在走廊里又怂了。
tip: 常见 get/got cold feet；婚礼场景高频。

dialog.en: So… about this weekend… maybe if you're free…
Stop beating around the bush — do you want to go or not?

dialog_zh: 那个……周末……如果你有空……——别拐弯抹角了，你去不去？
tip: 常与 stop/don't 连用；英式 beat about the bush。

dialog.en: Nobody's talking at this meeting.
Let's play a game to break the ice.

dialog_zh: 会上没人说话。——玩个游戏破破冰吧。
tip: icebreaker 指破冰活动。

dialog.en: The client rejected the design.
So we're back to square one.

dialog_zh: 客户否了设计。——那我们又回到原点了。
tip: 带有挫败感。

phrase: Cost an arm and a leg.

dialog.en: Nice watch!
Thanks, it cost an arm and a leg.

dialog_zh: 表真好看！——谢谢，贵死了。
tip: 夸张说法；主语是物品。

phrase: Kill two birds with one stone.

dialog.en: I'll visit Mom and shop downtown.
Nice, kill two birds with one stone.

dialog_zh: 我去看妈妈顺便市中心购物。——不错，一举两得。
tip: 与中文成语几乎完全对应。

dialog.en: The meeting got cancelled.
Great, I'm off the hook!

dialog_zh: 会取消了。——太好了，我解脱了！
tip: let sb off the hook = 放过某人。

dialog.en: Do you get along with your boss?
We don't always see eye to eye.

dialog_zh: 你和老板合得来吗？——我们看法不总一致。
tip: 多用于否定句。

dialog.en: Tickets sold out in an hour.
Oh no, I missed the boat.

dialog_zh: 票一小时就卖光了。——啊，我错过了。
tip: 强调机会已过。

dialog.en: What did you do at lunch?
Just shot the breeze with coworkers.

dialog_zh: 午饭干嘛了？——就跟同事闲聊。
tip: 指没目的的轻松聊天。

dialog.en: I didn't get the job.
Keep your chin up, something better will come.

dialog_zh: 我没拿到那份工作。——别灰心，会有更好的。
tip: 安慰鼓励用语。

dialog.en: Does that make sense?
Yes, that makes sense.

dialog_zh: 这样讲明白吗？——明白，讲得通。
tip: 注意第三人称 makes sense；make sense of = 弄懂。

dialog.en: The budget is limited this year.
In other words, no raises?

dialog_zh: 今年预算有限。——也就是说没有涨薪？
tip: 用于换个说法或总结。

dialog.en: Keep in mind the store closes at 9.
Thanks, I'll hurry.

dialog_zh: 记住商店九点关门。——谢谢，我抓紧。
tip: keep sth in mind / keep in mind that…

dialog.en: The city is exciting.
On the other hand, it's expensive.

dialog_zh: 城市很刺激。——另一方面也很贵。
tip: 常与 on the one hand 对比使用。

dialog.en: We were talking, and all of a sudden the lights went out.
That's scary!

dialog_zh: 我们正聊着，突然灯灭了。——好吓人！
tip: = suddenly，语气更口语。

dialog.en: Are you done?
More or less, just a few edits left.

dialog_zh: 做完了吗？——差不多，还剩点修改。
tip: 表示大致如此，不完全精确。

dialog.en: I'm moving to Shanghai next month.
I'll miss you! Keep in touch, okay?

dialog_zh: 我下个月要搬去上海了。——我会想你的！记得保持联系哦。
tip: 常用于道别，语气亲切；也可说 stay in touch。注意别说成 keep in contact with touch，“和某人保持联系”是 keep in touch with sb。

meaning: 产生影响；起作用（多指积极的改变）

dialog.en: Do you think volunteering one day a week really helps?
Absolutely. Every little bit makes a difference.

dialog_zh: 你觉得每周做一天志愿者真有用吗？——当然，每一点努力都会带来改变。
tip: 多为正面含义；“影响很大”说 make a big difference，“没什么区别”说 It doesn't make any difference。注意用 make 不用 do。

meaning: 来来回回；反复（犹豫、来回沟通）

dialog.en: Have you decided on the new job?
Not yet. I keep going back and forth about it.

dialog_zh: 新工作你决定了吗？——还没，我一直犹豫不定。
tip: 固定语序是 back and forth，不说 forth and back；go back and forth on/about sth 表示反复犹豫，也可指邮件、消息来回往来。

dialog.en: The party next door is getting really loud.
Yeah, if it gets out of hand, I'll call the building manager.

dialog_zh: 隔壁的派对越来越吵了。——是啊，要是闹得不可收拾，我就给物业打电话。
tip: 常用 get / got / getting out of hand，主语多是局面、情绪、花销、派对等；也说 things got out of hand（事情闹大了）。注意 out of hand 中间没有 the。

meaning: 反应快、机灵；做事麻利靠谱

dialog.en: I've already booked the meeting room and sent the agenda.
Wow, you're really on the ball today!

dialog_zh: 我已经订好会议室，也把议程发出去了。——哇，你今天效率真高！
tip: 常说 be on the ball（表扬人机灵、做事到位）；催人抓紧可说 Get on the ball!；否定 I wasn't on the ball today 表示今天状态不好、反应慢。

dialog.en: I have no idea how to set up this printer.
Come on, it's not rocket science. Just plug it in and follow the steps.

dialog_zh: 我完全不知道这台打印机怎么装。——拜托，这又不难，插上电按步骤来就行。
tip: 用来安慰或鼓励对方“没那么难”，语气重时也可能带点不耐烦；类似说法 It's not brain surgery。

meaning: 弄懂、想明白（某个复杂或难以接受的事）

dialog.en: So the new system tracks everything automatically?
Yeah, it took me a week to wrap my head around it.

dialog_zh: 所以新系统会自动记录所有东西？——对，我花了一周才搞明白。
tip: 多用于否定或“花了好久才”：I can't wrap my head around it.（我实在想不通）；注意 head 跟着主语变：my/his/their head(s)。

phrase: Go back to the drawing board.
meaning: （计划失败后）推倒重来，从头再想办法

dialog.en: The client rejected all three designs.
Well, back to the drawing board, then.

dialog_zh: 客户把三个方案全否了。——那好吧，只能从头再来了。
tip: 常省略成 Back to the drawing board. 带点无奈但不气馁的语气；别说成 go back to the draw board。

meaning: 偷工减料；图省事走捷径（常导致质量变差）

dialog.en: We could skip the testing to finish by Friday.
No way. We can't cut corners on safety.

dialog_zh: 我们可以跳过测试，赶在周五前完成。——不行，安全方面不能偷工减料。
tip: 多含贬义，常见搭配 cut corners on sth；corners 必须用复数，也可说 cut a few corners。

phrase: Give someone the benefit of the doubt.
literal: 把“存疑”的好处让给某人
meaning: 在没有确凿证据时，姑且相信某人（往好的方面想），不先怀疑他

dialog.en: He says he missed the meeting because his train was late.
He's never late, so let's give him the benefit of the doubt.

dialog_zh: 他说是因为火车晚点才没来开会。——他从来不迟到，咱们就姑且相信他吧。
tip: 常用 I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.（这次先信你一回）；doubt 用单数，别说成 doubts；被动可说 be given the benefit of the doubt。

meaning: 忍无可忍了；（一连串糟心事中）最后让人爆发的那件事

dialog.en: The neighbors are playing loud music at 2 a.m. again.
That's the last straw. I'm calling the landlord.

dialog_zh: 邻居凌晨两点又在放很吵的音乐。——这下真忍不了了，我要给房东打电话。
tip: 带明显的恼火、要采取行动的语气；常说 That was the last straw.，完整说法是 the straw that broke the camel's back（压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草）。

phrase: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
literal: 等我们走到桥边再过桥
meaning: 到时候再说；问题真出现了再想办法，现在不必提前担心

dialog.en: What if the client wants even more changes next month?
We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.

dialog_zh: 要是客户下个月还要改更多怎么办？——到时候再说吧。
tip: 语气轻松、劝人别杞人忧天；主语可换成 I'll，固定用 that bridge 和 come to it，别说成 go to it 或 arrive it。

meaning: 更糟糕的是；雪上加霜的是（引出又一件坏事）

dialog.en: How was your trip?
Awful. Our flight was delayed, and to make matters worse, they lost my bag.

dialog_zh: 旅行怎么样？——糟透了。航班延误了，更糟的是，他们还把我的行李弄丢了。
tip: 放在句首、后面加逗号，用来接着讲第二件坏事；matters 必须用复数，别说成 to make matter worse 或 to make things worser。

dialog.en: Sorry I'm five minutes late.
Relax, I'm not going to get bent out of shape over five minutes.

dialog_zh: 抱歉我迟到了五分钟。——放松，我不会为五分钟就不高兴的。
tip: 口语、偏随意，常用于劝人别为小事生气：Don't get bent out of shape about it.；搭配 about/over sth，也常说 all bent out of shape（气得不行）。

meaning: 因祸得福；坏事变好事（当时看似坏事，后来证明是好事）

dialog.en: I'm sorry you missed that job offer.
Honestly, it was a blessing in disguise. I found a much better one a week later.

dialog_zh: 很遗憾你错过了那份工作。——说实话，这是因祸得福，一周后我找到了一份好得多的。
tip: 通常说 It was / turned out to be a blessing in disguise，多用于事后回头看；别漏掉 a，也别说成 a blessing in disguised。

meaning: 多得很、到处都是、很普通不稀罕

dialog.en: Should I buy this phone case? It's only five dollars.
Don't bother. Cases like that are a dime a dozen online.

dialog_zh: 我该买这个手机壳吗？才五美元。——别买了，那种壳网上一抓一大把。
tip: 带点贬义，暗示「不值钱、不特别」；常用 be a dime a dozen 作表语，主语通常是复数（Good ideas are a dime a dozen.）；别说成 a dime of dozen。

literal: 晚一点总比永远不做好
meaning: 迟做总比不做强；虽然晚了，但总算来了／做了

dialog.en: Sorry, I finally sent you that birthday card. It's two weeks late.
Hey, better late than never. Thanks!

dialog_zh: 抱歉，我终于把生日贺卡寄给你了，晚了两周。——嘿，迟到总比不到好，谢谢！
tip: 多用来宽慰或自嘲，语气轻松；对别人迟到时说可能带点调侃。固定顺序是 better late than never，别说成 late is better than never。

meaning: 慢点、小心点、别急、别用力过猛（提醒动作要轻、要稳，也可劝人冷静）

dialog.en: Okay, let's lift the TV onto the stand.
Easy does it... slowly... perfect.

dialog_zh: 好，我们把电视抬到架子上。——慢点、小心……慢慢来……好了。
tip: 是固定说法，不随人称变化（不说 Easy do it）；常在搬东西、扶人、倒车时说，也可用来让激动的人冷静下来，相当于 Take it easy / Careful.

meaning: 振作起来、把状态调整好，别再散漫拖拉，好好把事情处理妥当

dialog.en: I missed another deadline and my room is a total mess.
Come on, you need to get your act together before the exam.

dialog_zh: 我又错过了一个截止日期，房间也乱成一团。——拜托，考试前你得振作起来、把状态调整好。
tip: 语气偏直接，带点批评或催促，对上级慎用；act 随主语变：get my / his / their act together，过去式 got my act together。

meaning: 不吃苦就没有收获；想要成果就得付出努力（常用于健身、学习）

dialog.en: My legs are killing me after that workout.
No pain, no gain! You'll feel stronger next week.

dialog_zh: 练完腿疼死了。——不吃苦哪有收获！下周你就会觉得更有劲了。
tip: 多用来给人（或自己）打气，语气积极；固定说法，中间不加 and，不要说成 No pains, no gains（那是很老的旧式说法）。

meaning: 冷静下来、振作起来，控制住情绪（别慌、别哭、别乱）

dialog.en: I can't do this presentation. I'm shaking!
Hey, pull yourself together. Take a deep breath — you know this stuff.

dialog_zh: 我做不了这个报告，我在发抖！——嘿，冷静点、振作起来。深呼吸，这些内容你都懂的。
tip: 针对情绪失控（慌乱、哭泣、崩溃）时说，语气可能有点生硬，安慰时可加 Hey 或先表示理解；yourself 随人称变：pull himself / ourselves together。和 Get your act together 不同，后者偏“别散漫、把事做好”。

meaning: 两全其美；同时享有两种不同事物的好处

dialog.en: I work from home two days a week and go to the office the other three.
Nice — you get the best of both worlds.

dialog_zh: 我一周两天在家办公，另外三天去公司。——不错啊，两全其美。
tip: 常说 get / have / enjoy the best of both worlds，几乎总带 the；语气积极。反过来说“没法两全”可以用 You can't have the best of both worlds 或 You can't have your cake and eat it too。别说成 the best of two worlds。

phrase: Let the cat out of the bag.
meaning: （往往是无意中）泄露秘密、说漏嘴

dialog.en: Why does Jamie already know about her surprise party?
Sorry, that was me. I let the cat out of the bag at lunch.

dialog_zh: 杰米怎么已经知道她的惊喜派对了？——抱歉，是我。我午饭时说漏嘴了。
tip: 多指不小心泄密，口语里很常用，语气轻松；动词随时态变：let 的过去式还是 let；也常说 The cat's out of the bag（秘密已经藏不住了）。意思接近 spill the beans。别说成 let the cat out of the box。

meaning: 雪上加霜；伤口上撒盐，让本来就糟的情况更糟、更让人难堪

dialog.en: My flight was cancelled, and then they lost my suitcase.
Ugh. And to add insult to injury, they charged you for the bag, right?

dialog_zh: 我的航班被取消了，然后他们还把我的箱子弄丢了。——唉。更气人的是，他们还收了你的行李费，对吧？
tip: 最常见的说法是 To add insult to injury, ...（放在句首引出“更糟的是”）；也可说 That's adding insult to injury。insult 和 injury 都用单数、不加冠词，别说成 add an insult to the injury。

phrase: Bite off more than you can chew.
literal: 咬下超过你能嚼得动的量
meaning: 不自量力；揽下超过自己能力的事

dialog.en: She took on three projects at once and a night class.
Yeah… she really bit off more than she can chew.

dialog_zh: 她同时接了三个项目，还报了夜校。——是啊……她真是不自量力。
tip: 常用 Don't bite off more than you can chew（别揽太多）；过去式/分词常说 bit/bitten off more than … can chew。someone/she/he 可替换主语。

meaning: 找错对象；搞错方向；错怪了人

dialog.en: Did you delete my files?
You're barking up the wrong tree — I wasn't even here yesterday.

dialog_zh: 是你把我的文件删了吗？——你找错人了——我昨天根本不在。
tip: 常用 You're barking up the wrong tree；也可说 bark up the wrong tree（不定式/原形）。语气偏口语，带一点责备或澄清。

phrase: By the skin of your teeth.
literal: 靠着你牙齿上的那层皮
meaning: 勉强；侥幸；差一点就没做成（勉强赶上/逃脱）

dialog.en: Did you catch the train?
Barely — I made it by the skin of my teeth.

dialog_zh: 赶上火车了吗？——勉强——差一点就错过了。
tip: 最常见是 by the skin of my/your/his teeth；也可说 make it / escape / pass by the skin of one's teeth。强调“险些不行”，不是轻松完成。

phrase: At the drop of a hat.

dialog.en: Would you help me move this weekend?
Sure — I'd do it at the drop of a hat.

dialog_zh: 这周末帮我搬家吗？——当然——我立刻就去。
tip: 强调愿意立刻行动，不需计划；常接 would / ready to / leave…

phrase: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
meaning: 别过早乐观；事未成不要先高兴

dialog.en: I'm already planning how to spend the bonus.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch — we haven't gotten it yet.

dialog_zh: 我已经在计划怎么花奖金了。——别高兴太早——我们还没拿到呢。
tip: 完整谚语；口语也常缩成 Don't count your chickens。

phrase: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
literal: 别把所有鸡蛋放进同一个篮子
meaning: 别把希望/资源全押在一件事上；要分散风险

dialog.en: I'm quitting my job to invest everything in one startup.
Don't put all your eggs in one basket.

dialog_zh: 我要辞职，把钱全投进一家初创公司。——别把所有鸡蛋放进同一个篮子。
tip: 投资、求职、计划都常用；也可以说 put all your eggs in one basket（陈述）。

phrase: Every cloud has a silver lining.
meaning: 黑暗中总有一线光明；坏事里也有好的一面

dialog.en: I got laid off, but now I finally have time to finish my novel.
Every cloud has a silver lining.

dialog_zh: 我被裁了，但终于有时间写完小说了。——塞翁失马，焉知非福。
tip: 安慰别人或自我宽心时常用；也可只说 a silver lining。

dialog.en: Why is Mia ignoring me at lunch?
She's giving you the cold shoulder after you canceled on her.

dialog_zh: 米娅午饭时怎么不理我？——你放她鸽子了，她在冷落你。
tip: 带疏远、赌气的语气；也可以说 get the cold shoulder（被冷落）。

meaning: 有更重要的事要做；顾不上小事

dialog.en: Can you help me fix this typo?
Sorry — I've got bigger fish to fry right now.

dialog_zh: 能帮我改一下这个错字吗？——抱歉，我现在有更要紧的事。
tip: 常说 have/got bigger fish to fry；语气可略不客气，注意场合。

meaning: 处境危险；快惹麻烦了；如履薄冰

dialog.en: I've been late three times this week.
You're on thin ice with the boss — one more and you're out.

dialog_zh: 这周我已经迟到三次了。——你在老板那儿已经如履薄冰了——再一次就完了。
tip: 常说 skating/walking on thin ice；警告别人别再冒险时很常用。

meaning: 故意唱反调；为了讨论更全面而提出反面意见

dialog.en: Everyone loves this plan. Should we just go ahead?
Let me play devil's advocate — what if the budget runs out?

dialog_zh: 大家都喜欢这个方案，直接推进吧？——我来唱个反调——万一预算花光了呢？
tip: 不是骂人邪恶；是为讨论故意提反对意见。也可说 playing devil's advocate。

meaning: 暂时搁置；推迟（计划/项目）

dialog.en: Can we launch the new feature next week?
Let's put it on ice until after the holidays.

dialog_zh: 下周能上线新功能吗？——先搁一搁，过完节再说。
tip: 和 on thin ice（处境危险）完全不同；on ice = 暂停/冷冻待用。

dialog.en: I just got the internship — I'm so excited!
I hate to rain on your parade, but have you checked the pay?

dialog_zh: 我拿到实习了，太兴奋了！——不想扫你的兴，不过你查过薪水吗？
tip: 固定搭配，一般不说 rain on my picnic；常带 I hate to… 表示不得不扫兴。

dialog.en: Should I spend my bonus on a new phone?
Maybe save some for a rainy day — you never know.

dialog_zh: 奖金要不要花在新手机上？——留一点以备不时之需吧，谁说得准。
tip: rainy day 这里不是字面雨天，而是紧急/困难时期；常指存钱。

phrase: Take it with a grain of salt.

dialog.en: He said the project will finish next week.
I'd take that with a grain of salt — he's always optimistic.

dialog_zh: 他说项目下周就能完成。——这话我半信半疑，他一向过于乐观。
tip: 也可说 with a pinch of salt；强调保留怀疑，不是完全否定。

meaning: 大家都心知肚明却故意不谈的明显问题

dialog.en: Everyone keeps talking about next quarter's goals.
Yeah, but the elephant in the room is that we're losing customers.

dialog_zh: 大家都在谈下季度目标。——可房间里的大象是：我们正在丢客户。
tip: 不是真有大象；指明显却被回避的尴尬/重大问题。常说 the elephant in the room。

meaning: 全部；一应俱全；做到极致

dialog.en: What did you get for the party?
Cake, balloons, a DJ — the whole nine yards.

dialog_zh: 派对你准备了什么？——蛋糕、气球、DJ——全套配齐。
tip: 意思是 everything / the full package；出处众说纷纭，日常当「全套」用即可。

meaning: 不顾风险；豁出去；大胆一试

dialog.en: Should we stick to the safe plan?
Let's throw caution to the wind and try something new.

dialog_zh: 要不要还是走稳妥方案？——不如豁出去，试试新的。
tip: 强调不顾后果地冒险；也可说 throwing/threw caution to the wind。

phrase: You can't judge a book by its cover.
literal: 你不能凭封面判断一本书
meaning: 不能只凭外表判断人或事物；别以貌取人

dialog.en: He looks messy — can he really handle this project?
You can't judge a book by its cover. He's one of our best engineers.

dialog_zh: 他看着挺邋遢——真能扛这个项目？——人不可貌相。他可是我们最强的工程师之一。
tip: 常说 You can't / Don't judge a book by its cover；指外表≠实质。

meaning: 行动胜于空谈；看你做什么比听你说什么更重要

dialog.en: He keeps promising he'll help this weekend.
We'll see. Actions speak louder than words.

dialog_zh: 他一直说周末会来帮忙。——走着瞧吧。行动比嘴巴响。
tip: 强调用行动证明；也可说 Actions speak louder than words. 作整句谚语。

meaning: 把两个本质不同的事物硬作比较；毫无意义的对比

dialog.en: Our app has fewer users than that social network.
That's comparing apples to oranges — we're a niche tool, not a social platform.

dialog_zh: 我们的应用用户比那个社交网络少。——这是拿苹果比橙子——我们是小众工具，不是社交平台。
tip: 也常说 comparing apples and oranges / that's apples and oranges；指不可比。

phrase: Get a taste of your own medicine.
meaning: 自食其果；让某人尝尝自己惯用手段的滋味（常指以其人之道还治其人之身）

dialog.en: He always mocks people for being late — and today he missed the meeting.
Good. Now he can get a taste of his own medicine.

dialog_zh: 他老是嘲笑别人迟到——结果今天他自己没赶上会。——好啊。这下他也该尝尝自己惯用的那一套了。
tip: 也常说 a taste of one's own medicine / give someone a taste of their own medicine；偏报复或反讽语气。

phrase: Go on a wild goose chase.
meaning: 徒劳无功的追寻；白跑一趟、白忙一场

dialog.en: I spent three hours looking for that old warehouse downtown.
Sounds like you went on a wild goose chase — it closed years ago.

dialog_zh: 我在市中心找那栋旧仓库找了三个小时。——听着像白忙一场——那地方几年前就关了。
tip: 名词短语 a wild goose chase 更常见；也可说 send someone on a wild goose chase。

meaning: 多种不利因素同时叠加造成的最坏局面；危机的叠加

dialog.en: Why did the launch fail so badly?
Budget cuts, a key engineer quitting, and a server outage — a perfect storm.

dialog_zh: 这次上线怎么砸得这么惨？——预算砍了、核心工程师离职、再加上服务器宕机——多种倒霉事撞在一起了。
tip: 比喻用法居多；可说 create / face a perfect storm；源自多种气象条件同时出现。

phrase: The devil is in the details.
meaning: 关键往往出在细节上；事情看起来简单，真正难的是细节

dialog.en: The plan looks solid overall.
Maybe — but the devil is in the details.

dialog_zh: 整体计划看起来挺靠谱。——也许吧——但关键往往出在细节上。
tip: 也常说 the devil's in the details；强调落实/核对细节时用。

phrase: There are other fish in the sea.
meaning: 天涯何处无芳草；失去一个人/机会后还有很多别的选择（常用于安慰失恋）

dialog.en: I can't believe she dumped me.
Cheer up — there are other fish in the sea.

dialog_zh: 真不敢相信她甩了我。——振作点——天涯何处无芳草。
tip: 安慰失恋/错过机会时很常见；语气轻松，别用在对方刚受重创时显得轻飘。

phrase: You can't have your cake and eat it too.
literal: 你不能既留着蛋糕又把它吃掉
meaning: 鱼与熊掌不可兼得；不能同时拥有相互冲突的好处

dialog.en: I want to quit my job and still keep the salary.
You can't have your cake and eat it too.

dialog_zh: 我想辞职又想照拿工资。——鱼与熊掌不可兼得。
tip: 美式常说 have your cake and eat it too；英式语序有时是 eat your cake and have it；否定句最常见。

meaning: 绝不可能；除非太阳从西边出来

dialog.en: Do you think he'll finally clean his room this weekend?
Yeah, when pigs fly.

dialog_zh: 你觉得他这周末终于会打扫房间吗？——会啊，等猪飞起来那天吧。
tip: 讽刺语气强；也说 That'll happen when pigs fly.；类似中文「除非太阳从西边出来」。

meaning: 花光所有钱；昂贵到倾家荡产（也有赌博语境）

dialog.en: This restaurant looks fancy — can we afford it?
Don't worry, it won't break the bank.

dialog_zh: 这家餐厅看着挺高档——我们吃得起吗？——别担心，不会花到倾家荡产。
tip: 否定句 won't break the bank 极常见，表示「不太贵」；肯定句可指赌输或花光钱。

dialog.en: You look exhausted. What happened?
I had to burn the midnight oil to finish the report.

dialog_zh: 你看起来累坏了。怎么了？——我得熬夜把报告赶完。
tip: burn / burned / burnt the midnight oil 均可；强调为工作或学习而熬夜，不是单纯晚睡。

literal: 当场抓住某人双手还是红的
meaning: 当场抓住某人做坏事；逮个正着

dialog.en: How did they know he was stealing from the till?
The security camera caught him red-handed.

dialog_zh: 他们怎么知道他在偷柜台的钱？——监控把他当场抓了个正着。
tip: red-handed 作补语：catch/be caught red-handed；也可说 catch someone in the act。

meaning: 掌握窍门；学会怎么做；上手

dialog.en: This software feels so confusing.
Give it a week — you'll get the hang of it.

dialog_zh: 这软件感觉好乱。——给它一周，你就上手了。
tip: get the hang of something / of it；强调通过练习逐渐熟练，不是瞬间学会。

dialog.en: We're going to the amusement park tomorrow.
Nice! Have a blast!

dialog_zh: 我们明天要去游乐园。——太好了！玩得开心点！
tip: 口语祝福或事后描述：Have a blast! / We had a blast.；语气轻松愉快。

dialog.en: I forgot to turn in the report.
You're in hot water with the boss now.

dialog_zh: 我忘了交报告。——你这下在老板那儿麻烦大了。
tip: be/get in hot water (with someone)；表示因做错事而惹上麻烦。

dialog.en: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
Sure, go ahead.

dialog_zh: 能帮我看着包吗？——没问题，你去吧。
tip: keep an eye on someone/something = watch carefully；也可说 keep one's eye on。

dialog.en: The customer was yelling.
Don't lose your cool — stay calm.

dialog_zh: 那个顾客在大喊大叫。——别沉不住气，保持冷静。
tip: lose one's cool；反义 keep one's cool；指一时失控发火。

meaning: 收入刚够维持生活，勉强维持

dialog.en: Money is tight this month.
Yeah, we are just making ends meet.

dialog_zh: A：这个月钱很紧。B：是啊，我们只是勉强维持。
tip: 常与 just / barely 搭配，强调刚刚够。

dialog.en: Thanks for dinner!
My treat. I will pick up the tab.

dialog_zh: A：谢谢请客！B：我请。我来买单。
tip: tab 指账单；近义还有 foot the bill。

dialog.en: Can I stay out late again?
No. I am putting my foot down this time.

dialog_zh: A：我能再外出晚回吗？B：不行。这次我要坚决一点。
tip: 常用 put my/your foot down，表示坚决拒绝。

meaning: 领会言外之意；听出弦外之音

dialog.en: She said she was fine, but I could tell something was wrong.
Yeah, you have to read between the lines.

dialog_zh: A：她说自己没事，但我看得出有问题。B：是啊，你得听出弦外之音。
tip: 常指从字面之外推断真实意思；也可说 reading between the lines。

meaning: 经验法则；大致可行的简便标准

dialog.en: How much tip should I leave?
A good rule of thumb is fifteen to twenty percent.

dialog_zh: A：我该留多少小费？B：经验法则是百分之十五到二十。
tip: 常作 a rule of thumb；表示非精确但实用的经验标准。

meaning: 耐心等着；先别动；别轻举妄动

dialog.en: Should we leave now?
Sit tight. The taxi will be here in five minutes.

dialog_zh: A：我们现在该走了吗？B：先等着。出租车五分钟就到。
tip: 口语常用祈使句 Sit tight；语气是安抚、让人耐心等待。

phrase: Take something with a pinch of salt.
literal: 把某事配一小撮盐一起吃
meaning: 对某事半信半疑；听着别全当真

dialog.en: He said he made a million dollars last year.
I would take that with a pinch of salt.

dialog_zh: A：他说他去年赚了一百万美元。B：这话我可半信半疑。
tip: 也常说 take it with a grain of salt；pinch 与 grain 都可，美式更常 grain。

meaning: 只是冰山一角；表面看到的只是问题的一小部分

dialog.en: Is the delayed shipment our only problem?
I am afraid that is just the tip of the iceberg.

dialog_zh: A：延误发货是我们唯一的问题吗？B：恐怕那只是冰山一角。
tip: 常作 just the tip of the iceberg；强调还有更大、更糟的部分没露出来。

meaning: 跳出固有思路；打破常规想办法

dialog.en: We have tried everything and still cannot fix this.
We need to think outside the box.

dialog_zh: A：我们什么都试了，还是修不好。B：我们得跳出固有思路。
tip: 商务与创意场合很常见；也可说 thinking outside the box。

dialog.en: Have you decided on a vacation destination yet?
No, our plans are still up in the air.

dialog_zh: A：你们定好度假去哪儿了吗？B：还没有，计划还悬而未决。
tip: 常说 still up in the air；指事情还没敲定，不是字面“在天上”。

meaning: 过去的事就过去了；不必再计较

dialog.en: Sorry about that argument last year.
Don't worry. It's water under the bridge.

dialog_zh: A：去年那次吵架真不好意思。B：别担心，都过去了。
tip: 强调旧怨不必再提；也可说 that's all water under the bridge。

meaning: 祸不单行；坏事一来就成串

dialog.en: I lost my wallet, then my car broke down.
When it rains, it pours.

dialog_zh: A：我丢了钱包，然后车又坏了。B：真是祸不单行。
tip: 也可用于好事成串；美式拼写 pours，不是 pores。

dialog.en: Can I tell Mom what we bought her?
No—zip your lip. It's a surprise.

dialog_zh: A：我能告诉妈妈我们给她买了什么吗？B：不行——闭嘴，这是惊喜。
tip: 常用于叮嘱别泄密或别多嘴；语气偏口语、略强硬，对长辈要慎用。

meaning: 竭尽全力（常为帮助别人）；煞费苦心

dialog.en: Did the hotel help with your early check-in?
Yes, they bent over backwards to make us comfortable.

dialog_zh: A：酒店帮你们提早入住了吗？B：帮了，他们千方百计让我们住得舒服。
tip: bend/bent over backwards；强调付出超出寻常的努力，常接 to do something。

meaning: 发泄情绪；消消气（如运动、大喊）

dialog.en: You're slamming doors. Everything okay?
Rough day at work. I just need to blow off steam.

dialog_zh: A：你一直摔门，没事吧？B：上班糟透了，只是想发泄一下。
tip: 也可说 let off steam；指释放压力，不是「吹牛」(blow smoke)。
